caption: The drawing depicts a single, ornate glass decanter with a handle and a pointed stopper. The decanter is predominantly deep blue with lighter blue and white highlights, giving it a reflective, glossy look. It features a band of gold around its neck and is decorated with painted white, yellow, and orange floral patterns along its body, with black curved lines representing stems or vines. The stopper on top is a dark teal blue, faceted, and conical in shape. The decanter sits on a plain, light beige background with no other objects present. There is a signature in the lower right corner of the drawing that reads “Stewart.”
title: Cruet
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
